events.name: Snake River Invitational Day 1
events.info: Ticket grants admission to both games on DAY 1 ONLY! Re-enty is allowed into venue for this event. Get ready for three days of NCAA Division I college men's basketball at the Snake River Invitational in the Mountain America Center, November 27?29, 2026! The inaugural Snake River Invitational brings together four NCAA Division I programs ? Boise State, Drake, North Texas and North Dakota State ? for a three-day event featuring six individual matchups, two games a day, giving fans the opportunity to see all four teams compete against each other. Representing the Pac-12 Conference, Missouri Valley Conference, American Athletic Conference and Summit League, the four participating programs bring a combined résumé of 28 NCAA Tournament appearances, multiple conference championships and postseason success in both the NCAA Tournament and NIT. FRIDAY, NOVEMBER 27 Game 1: North Dakota State vs. North Texas Game 2: Boise State vs. Drake Game times are TBA and Subject to Change
